title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Your pre-game routine
hook: What do you do in the hour before a game?
intro: You rush from work to the field.
The game starts and you are still catching up.
statement: A calm coach helps make a calm team.
q1: Do you have a set routine before every game —
q2: or take each game day as it comes?
t1: There is no single right way. But teams settle
cta: Coaches — what is your pre-game routine?
ctaLines: Lineup the night before. Arrive early. A quiet minute.
Routine or take it as it comes?
ctaPrompt: Share your routine below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What do you do in the hour before a game?
You rush from work to the field. The game starts and you are still catching up.
A calm coach helps make a calm team.
A set routine or take it as it comes. There is no perfect answer.
What is your pre-game routine? Share your habit in the comments.
